def is_palindrome(s):
    """
    Return True iff `s` is a palindrome, ignoring case and
    non-alphanumeric characters.

    An empty string (or a string containing no alphanumeric
    characters) is considered a palindrome.
    """
    cleaned = [ch.lower() for ch in s if ch.isalnum()]
    return cleaned == cleaned[::-1]
